summary: Warps through time by sampling different depth slices from a Texture 3D TOP sequence according to a second input image.

key_params.name: blackoffset
key_params.note: Time offset used where the control input is black

key_params.name: whiteoffset
key_params.note: Time offset used where the control input is white

common_gotchas: Input 1 must be a Texture 3D TOP containing the image sequence over depth.
Input 2 controls time offset and is expected to be monochrome; non-mono input uses the red channel.
Black and white offsets define the sampled time range, with gray values interpolating between them.
This warps time only, not spatial XY coordinates.
key_concepts: Time Machine TOP samples through the depth of a Texture 3D TOP to create per-pixel time offsets.
Input 2 is a time-control image: black and white values map to the configured black and white offsets, with gray values interpolating.
The operator changes which temporal slice is read for each pixel while preserving the input XY location.
Unit controls let offsets be expressed in index, frame, second, or fractional terms as described by the official page.
